abstract.p: The invention relates to a an organic electroluminescent device comprising at least one light-emitting layer B composed of one or more sublayers, wherein the one or more sublayers of the light-emitting layer B as a whole comprise at least one host material H<sup>B</sup>, at least one phosphorescence material P<sup>B</sup>, at least one small FWHM emitter S<sup>B</sup>, and optionally at least one TADF material E<sup>B</sup>.
